test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the official language of Bangladesh, a neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Bengali **is the official language of** Bangladesh **and is spoken by the majority of the population in the country.
 
• Bangladesh was** previously known as East Pakistan,** and Bengali was recognized as an official language of Pakistan in 1956.
 
• After a long struggle, Bengali was declared the official language of **Bangladesh in 1971**, when the country gained independence from Pakistan.
 
• Bengali is also known as **Bangla,** and it is the **seventh most spoken language in the world, **with over 250 million speakers worldwide.
 
• Some other languages spoken in Bangladesh include** Rohingya, Chittagonian, Sylheti, and Rangpuri. **However, Bengali is the most widely spoken and the official language of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urdu** is the official language of Pakistan and is also spoken in some parts of India.
 
• **Dzongkha** is the official language of Bhutan and is not spoken in Bangladesh.
 
• **Hindi **is the official language of India and is also spoken in some parts of Nepal and Mauritius.
